label: HORKOS
title: Your token. Your fees. Your word.
subtitle: Trading-fee commitments for token launchers and holders.
narration: Horkos lets token launchers make verifiable commitments about their trading fee income. Holders can inspect the promise and the money without connecting a wallet.

label: THE ECOSYSTEM
title: Ascend launches. Horkos adds a pledge.
subtitle: Elysium is the chain. Ascend is the launch platform.
narration: Ascend is building token launch infrastructure on Elysium. Our demo tokens were deployed directly to the testnet. Real Ascend fee routing remains unverified.

label: FOLLOW THE MONEY
title: The default fee split, made clear.
subtitle: Illustration of our mock model. No actual swap.
narration: A thousand unit trade illustrates a ten unit fee. The launcher quarter share is two point five units, routed into a pledge vault. Our mock transfers fees only.

label: DAPP FLOW
title: Token. Pledge. Terms.
subtitle: Connect on chain 99801, choose terms, confirm explicitly.
narration: The dapp lets an operator select a token, choose vesting or burn, and set immutable terms. This animated workflow illustrates the interface; it does not claim a new transaction.

label: LIVE TESTNET RECORD
title: Lock first. Release over time.
subtitle: Prepared sample / one-day cliff / thirty-day duration.
narration: The real vesting sample has received seven point five OATH, held under a one day cliff and thirty day schedule. Its deposits and events are public.

label: LIVE TESTNET RECORD
title: A defined share, sent away.
subtitle: Prepared sample / 50% dead-address allocation.
narration: The burn sample settled three point seven five OATH to the launcher, and the same amount to the dead address. Its period is still Active.

label: THE COMMITMENT
title: Diversion leaves a permanent record.
subtitle: Illustration only. Deposited fees remain bound.
narration: Changing the recipient permanently marks a pledge Breached, while existing deposits stay bound. This scene illustrates that rule; the samples remain unchanged.

label: PUBLIC API
title: Evidence other tools can read.
subtitle: Amounts, verdict, checked block, explicit mock source.
narration: Our A P I exposes amounts, status, and a checked block, with an explicit mock hook source. Next is validating real Ascend integration. Horkos makes fee promises inspectable.
